title: Choose the word that can bear honor
summary: Speech carries your honor long before reputation does. Return the mouth to praise before it carries hurt.
takeaway: Return the mouth to praise before it carries hurt.
lifeApplication: Before the next message leaves your mouth, pause with one breath and choose the sentence that can still be honored tonight.

source.shortMeaning: Speech carries your honor long before reputation does.
source.lifeApplication: Before replying sharply, speak only what you could repeat before the Guru.

evidence.coreClaim: Speech carries your honor long before reputation does.
evidence.turn: Keep only the speech that can stand at God's Door.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before the next message leaves your mouth, pause with one breath and choose the sentence that can still be honored tonight.
